courses.subject: SGCL
courses.title: Suicide Prevention and Crisis Intervention
courses.description: This course examines suicide as a school crisis in particular and as a specific crisis in the wider perspective of crisis intervention theory and applications. Students will be introduced to misconceptions of suicide, assessment of risk, critical incident stress debriefing, basic intervention skills, prevention, intervention, and postvention strategies.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA School Guidance & Counselling
courses.course_syllabus:
Suicidal behavior: Theories and classification; understanding self-injurious behaviour/ ethical issues; suicide assessment & prevention; crisis intervention/suicidal crisis; intervention

courses.subject: SGCL
courses.title: Cross-Cultural Counselling
courses.description: This course is designed to enhance the ability of counsellors to work with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds based on a model of cross-cultural competence emphasizing awareness, knowledge and skills. Students are invited to examine their attitudes and beliefs toward different cultural groups, and to become aware of biases that might inhibit cross-cultural interactions. Selected theories and research on cross-cultural and multicultural counselling are introduced, with special attention paid to sub-cultures among the three Chinese societies. Students are also given the opportunity to learn and practice cross-cultural counselling skills and intervention strategies.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA School Guidance & Counselling
courses.course_syllabus:
Multicultural Counselling Competencies; Ethnic Identity & Racial Salience; Acculturation, Acculturative Stress, & Intergenerational Conflicts; Worldview & Value Orientations; Counselling Theories for Chinese

courses.subject: SGCL
courses.title: Selected Topics in Guidance and Counselling
courses.description: This course is designed to provide in-depth exploration and discussion on selected current topics in school guidance and counselling. Examples of topic include advances in counselling theories and strategies, counselling individuals with diverse needs, assessment in counselling, advances in school guidance and guidance, and current professional and ethical issues in counselling.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For students in MA School Guidance & Counselling
courses.feedback_evaluation:
Students are encouraged to express their feedback to the instructor using the following methods:
1. Direct communication

3. End of course evaluation
